SYMPTOM: Keyboard extension page buttons (123, emoji, shift, delete) don't respond to Maestro taps of any kind.
CAUSE: Keyboard extensions handle touches in their own process/coordinate space — Maestro sends taps in full screen coordinates but keyboard elements live in a separate coordinate system.
FIX: There is no fix. Only `inputText` works through keyboard extensions — it bypasses the UIControl layer entirely.
PREVENT: Don't waste time trying coordinate tweaks. For page-switching tests, use XCUITest instead of Maestro. For Maestro, limit keyboard tests to: activate keyboard, inputText, assertVisible on typed text, takeScreenshot.
